title: Render owner-authorized canonical Incident headline, severity, priority and impact on existing Command Incident Detail
goal: Complete the read-only business header of the existing authenticated Class-0 Incident Detail using one optional Command-owned projection. No invented data, unauthorized source metadata, mutation or new route.
invariants: The selected Incident must be reauthorized through existing Command SessionResolver+Owner.List/CanRead+Project before any optional canonical overview source lookup.

The new optional IncidentOverviewOwner is a Command host implementation, not client-provided field values, scope or permission; it must reauthorize principal, tenant, environment and incident, then provide source provenance.

Returned Incident ID, tenant and environment must match the already authenticated selection; title/priority/severity/business impact are optional and never inferred from status/factors/SLA or Case rights.
Any invalid source provenance, malformed UTF-8/control field, excessive source text, source failure or revoked Incident fails without emitting partial HTML or confidential values.
Missing optional source is shown explicitly as unavailable with no invented business fields, preserving existing backward compatible local hosts.
No mutations, source writes, export, Incident transition, new permission namespace, Govern action or production acceptance; current Work Queue and Investigate Case handlers retain original behavior.
security_properties: No unauthenticated or cross-tenant Incident ID may be used to fetch the optional source; input ID remains presentation-only.
No raw/secret source content is copied; only independently owner-authorized canonical header fields with ID, tenant, environment, version, source and observation time.
html/template escapes source-provided text and strict CSP/no-store/no-referrer remain intact.
Synthetic loopback demo exposes overview only for analyst principal while Command-only commander may see base Incident but no optional overview.

migration.rationale: Additive optional read-only HTML projection, no stored schema changes or new endpoint

rollback.strategy: Revert overview module, optional demo owner implementation and HTML template insertion; preexisting Incident Detail stays readable
verification: Old owner without optional interface still serves partial Detail

inputs: Existing #209 Incident Detail selected Command owner read, canonical OBJ-INCIDENT title/priority/severity/business-impact
Existing first-party local loopback synthetic host and trusted Command demo sessions
outputs: Selected Incident Detail shows actual Command-owner authorized title/priority/severity/business-impact and source provenance when available
Unavailable or intentionally withheld owner produces partial view with unknown values, preserving independent Case owner permissions
Exact source authorization, failure and HTML injection regression tests including actual local HTTP synthetic browser
acceptance_tests: Selected owner-authorized Incident on third Work Queue page displays correct canonical business attributes and provenance
Missing optional source or missing individual fields displays explicit partial/unknown and never guesses
Owner-revoked, wrong Incident, tenant, environment, failed/stale source, malformed observation time or sensitive text rejects without partial HTML
Safe escaping prevents owner title from becoming HTML or script; no CSP or caching relaxation
Run original Command Work Queue and same-origin host suites on Linux, Windows, macOS and global engineering/security checks on exact head
definition_of_ready: Canonical CAP-CMD-106 and OBJ-INCIDENT prescribe title, priority, severity and business impact read, and #209 real Class-0 detail has explicitly missing fields
Parent E10-CMD-106J-DETAILREAD is IMPLEMENTED on frozen #209 head; no production IAM decision is assumed
Source trust boundary remains the Command owner, not the browser or linked Investigate Case
definition_of_done: Source-authorized read-only detail visible in local browser, with correct unknown state when denied/unavailable
Exact commit Linux/macOS/Windows Go tests/vet/race and mandatory security checks SUCCESS
No source parent reviewed SHA changed, no merge or native GitHub approval falsely claimed

performance_budget.rationale: One additional optional owner lookup only after existing bounded at-most 5000 full owner checks; no extra auth engine or indexed storage; production SLO not asserted.
metrics: at most one optional Command overview owner lookup per allowed detail request
no more than one additional Go renderer field group
